record.name: Vertex 0: FDP-1 reference
record.definition: FDP-1 exactly as on main: pulsed magnetised D-3He point burn, three-loop Fiji-amplified magnetic nozzle, shadow shield, 600 K warm loop. Optimistic scenario tier.
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice (VTX-02A); the calculator gives it no numeric credit.
record.consistency: Kept as the 2026-11-08 record. Energy-inconsistent under the T04 compression bound (needs eta_c/alpha 1.68 for compression alone, 2.1 with the T04 ignitor); warm loop and nozzle definition superseded (T01, T03).

record.name: Vertex 1: advanced engineering, no new fictional effect
record.definition: V0 plus Level A/B engineering targets: split warm loop averaging 700 K, house load halved, driver galleries inside the hull cone. No added fictional property, no new collimation credit.
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice only, unchanged from V0.
record.consistency: Kept as the 2026-11-08 record. Energy-inconsistent under the T04 compression bound (needs eta_c/alpha 1.68 for compression alone, 2.1 with the T04 ignitor); warm loop and nozzle definition superseded (T01, T03).

changes.rationale: Cores at about 600 K (Curie limits), power conversion at about 773 K (SiC ICs shown for a year): an area-weighted warm loop near 700 K.
Target factory and controls at 0.05 % of fusion. The 0.1 % baseline is itself unsourced; this is a requirement, not a result.
Galleries folded inside the 7.9 deg equipment-module cone; the calculator re-sizes the shield. Routing inside the hull is unchecked.
The three canon H2 vessels are idle in FDP-1; removing them is a canon change (decision D-04). convergence.py also reports V1 with them kept.

record.name: Vertex 2: Fiji-integrated, canon-bounded
record.definition: V1 plus the strongest physically defensible targets: warm loop at 800 K, advanced tungsten armour at half areal mass. Fiji keeps exactly its canon card (VTX-02A); no extra Fiji property is assumed.
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice; the gap to any benchmark V2 misses is reported as extra capability that would be needed, not assumed.
record.consistency: Kept as the 2026-11-08 record. Energy-inconsistent under the T04 compression bound (needs eta_c/alpha 1.68 for compression alone, 2.1 with the T04 ignitor); warm loop and nozzle definition superseded (T01, T03).

changes.rationale: All machinery heat at 800 K: needs MW-class power electronics at 800 K and induction cores near their FINEMET limit (823-843 K).
As V1.

As V1.
Advanced W armour (MAT-W-ADV01) holding the allowed fluence at half the areal mass.

record.name: Vertex 3: corrected V1 (every thread correction, no new levers)
record.definition: Atlas V1 layout with every T01-T04 correction and nothing else: component-booked warm loop (628 K), bottom-up house load, driver efficiency 0.30, closure-coil nozzle C at 15 E_p, T02 skirt and loop shoes, a compression-consistent target at coupling 0.5. Shows what the corrections alone cost. Assumes, like FDP-1, that targets survive in flight (launcher constraint reported separately).
record.fictional: Canon Fiji lattice only (VTX-02A), no numeric credit. No Level C property.
record.consistency: Energy-consistent by construction: gain set at the T04 bound for the stated coupling and density.

changes.rationale: Galleries inside the hull cone (Atlas V1).
Hydrogen low gear out of the preferred configuration (owner 2026-11-09; T04 D-T04-2: no mission phase needs it). Canon keeps the vessels; convergence.py also reports them kept (+0.7-0.8 kt).
Published heavy-ion wall-plug efficiency, upper end (0.20-0.30); T01 planning value.
T01 component circuits (cores 640 K, power stages 740 K, capacitors 550 K, dumps 1,000 K) booked as one equivalent radiator: 628 K. Replaces the withdrawn 700-800 K loop (D-13).

T01 bottom-up house load at its planning case (advanced components, 4.4e-5; band 2.6e-5 to 1.2e-4). T06 used the band's lower edge 2.6e-5; T00 keeps the planning value (never the optimistic edge by default).

Thrust efficiency eta_T = eta_mom^2 of the closure-coil nozzle at 15 E_p (T03 ideal thin-shell model, an UPPER BOUND, not demonstrated; literature eta_T 0.30-0.64). convergence.py reports 0.740 (10 E_p) and 0.64 beside it.
15 E_p of stored field (T03: 1 E_p cannot stop the pulse; D-20).
Plume-strike share of the nozzle loss for nozzle C (T03 0.06-0.07).
T02 engine-side skirt (56 t central of 22-90 t) and LiH loop shoes (193 t) on the 990.2 t payload; their solid angle (+0.0127) is not booked (no calculator path).

Advanced research target for the driver-to-fuel coupling eta_c/alpha (owner 2026-11-09: retain >= 0.5 as a research target; no Level C compression physics declared; D-22). Present couplings are in the percent range (T04).
Fuel density for the bound; 2,000 g/cm3 is the lightest closing density at coupling 0.5 (T06 frontier; convergence.py rechecks 1,000-3,000).
T01 equivalent areal mass of the booked circuits (0.96 kg/m2, area-weighted over the circuit radiators).

liner_study.note: Fixed fuel rhoR, tamper mu kg per kg fuel, rest optimistic. ve = sqrt(2 eta_jet b eps / (1 + mu)). Tamper-enhanced burnup (inertial confinement by the tamper) is not modelled: b is held at the untampered value, so a burnup gain is UNKNOWN.

ve_sweep.note: Rocket equation on the whole four-burn delta-v; tanks, radiators and drive that scale with propellant are not included, so the real penalty is larger. Use of the low gear for short phases is a mission question (decision D-04).
